papers.title: TextSeal2: Distortion-Free LLM Watermarking with Copula Mixing and Memoryless Races
papers.summary: We present TextSeal2, a distortion-free watermark for large language models that keeps its signal under speculative decoding: tokens that replace rejected drafts remain watermarked with the same keys, and the acceptance rate is unchanged. It also preserves output diversity and adds no measurable inference latency. Its predecessor, TextSeal, restores diversity in the Gumbel-max scheme by routing each token to one of two keys via a coin flip. This is suboptimal because the detector averages the scores from both keys without knowing which key was used. TextSeal2 instead merges two or more keys into a single virtual key and couples it to fresh noise through AutoMark's Gaussian copula. Any number of keys, including publicly shared keys, can be merged this way without diluting detection. Under speculative decoding, TextSeal2 verifies keyed drafts with one more exponential race, run on the leftovers of the draft races. By memorylessness, this race reproduces block verification, so the output follows the target model exactly. We evaluate TextSeal2 on three LLMs. At equal output token diversity, TextSeal2 detects 8 to 22 percentage points more 100-token answers than TextSeal at a false-positive rate of $10^{-3}$, and is comparable to textGrain while requiring no post-logits optimization. Under speculative decoding, it detects 18 and 22 percentage points more 200-token answers than TextSeal and textGrain, respectively, at the same acceptance rate.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但证据广度仍不足
pros: 提出Copula混合与memoryless race结合，针对推测解码失真痛点有明确创新
声称在不降接受率、无额外延迟下显著提升检测率，工程落地价值较高
cons: 摘要未交代统计显著性、密钥管理安全性与跨任务泛化，严谨性与外部有效性仍有风险
对比范围主要限于少数基线与三种模型，难支撑顶会级普适结论

papers.title_zh: TextSeal2：具有 Copula 混合和无记忆竞赛的无失真 LLM 水印
papers.summary_zh: 我们提出了 TextSeal2，这是一种用于大型语言模型的无失真水印，可将其信号保持在推测解码下：替换被拒绝草稿的令牌仍使用相同的密钥加有水印，并且接受率保持不变。它还保留了输出多样性，并且不会增加可测量的推理延迟。它的前身 TextSeal 通过抛硬币将每个令牌路由到两个密钥之一，从而恢复了 Gumbel-max 方案的多样性。这是次优的，因为检测器在不知道使用哪个键的情况下对两个键的分数进行平均。相反，TextSeal2 将两个或多个键合并为一个虚拟键，并通过 AutoMark 的高斯联结函数将其与新噪声耦合。可以通过这种方式合并任意数量的密钥，包括公开共享的密钥，而不会削弱检测。在推测性解码下，TextSeal2 通过另一场指数竞赛来验证密钥草稿，并在草稿竞赛的剩余部分上运行。通过无记忆，这场竞赛重现了区块验证，因此输出完全遵循目标模型。我们在三个法学硕士上评估 TextSeal2。在相同的输出标记多样性下，TextSeal2 检测到的 100 个标记答案比 TextSeal 多 8 到 22 个百分点，误报率为 10^{-3}$，并且与 textGrain 相当，同时不需要 post-logits 优化。在推测解码下，在相同的接受率下，它检测到的 200 个标记的答案分别比 TextSeal 和 textGrain 多 18 个百分点和 22 个百分点。

papers.title: How to Loop Your Transformer: Loop Scaling, Specialization, and Parallel Inference
papers.summary: Looping in transformer models reuses weights by repeatedly applying the same transformer, or parts of it, making the model deeper without increasing its parameter count. Whether looping is useful depends on which constraint dominates: model size, training compute, or autoregressive inference efficiency. We study these trade-offs jointly in dense decoder-only transformers trained from scratch, varying which parts of the model are looped, how many loops are applied, and how information is passed between loops. Our experiments span models with up to 1B parameters, trained on up to 155B tokens with up to $1.07\times10^{21}$ FLOPs and 32 loops. We find that looping the full transformer generally gives the strongest quality at a fixed parameter budget, whereas looping a middle block of layers gives a better return when training FLOPs are constrained. Adding loops is not uniformly beneficial: gains eventually saturate, reverse, or become unstable. This motivates asking whether forcing every loop to use the same weights limits the benefit of deeper looping. We address this by adding small loop-specific low-rank adapters that improve quality, with larger gains as more loops are added. Looped transformers also suffer a decoding slowdown proportional to the number of loops. Parallel Loop Transformers address this by passing hidden states between loops across adjacent token positions, allowing loop stages to run concurrently. However, in our experiments the original formulation does not consistently retain the quality gains of ordinary looping. We find that preserving the current-token embedding and separately normalizing it and the previous-token hidden state before combining them recovers strong performance across model scales and training budgets. Together, these results show that effective looping requires matching the design to the resource constraint and inference setting.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 问题切中效率痛点，实验扎实但机制新颖性中等。
pros: 系统比较参数、训练算力与推理效率三重约束下的loop设计，结论具实用指导性
覆盖至1B规模与大算力训练，并提出并验证并行loop改进与专门化适配器策略
cons: 并行loop原方案效果不稳且改进依赖特定融合/归一化设计，跨任务与更大规模泛化仍有不确定性

papers.title_zh: 如何循环你的 Transformer：循环缩放、专业化和并行推理
papers.summary_zh: 变压器模型中的循环通过重复应用相同的变压器或其中的一部分来重用权重，使模型更深而不增加其参数数量。循环是否有用取决于哪个约束占主导地位：模型大小、训练计算或自回归推理效率。我们在从头开始训练的密集解码器变压器中联合研究这些权衡，改变模型的哪些部分被循环、应用多少个循环以及信息在循环之间传递的方式。我们的实验跨越具有多达 1B 个参数的模型，在多达 155B 个令牌上进行训练，并具有高达 $1.07\times10^{21}$ FLOP 和 32 个循环。我们发现，循环整个变压器通常在固定参数预算下提供最强的质量，而循环中间层块在训练 FLOP 受到限制时提供更好的回报。添加循环并不总是有益的：增益最终会饱和、逆转或变得不稳定。这促使人们询问是否强制每个循环使用相同的权重会限制更深循环的好处。我们通过添加小型循环特定的低阶适配器来解决这个问题，这些适配器可以提高质量，并且随着添加更多循环而获得更大的增益。循环变压器还遭受与循环数量成比例的解码减慢。并行循环变压器通过在相邻令牌位置的循环之间传递隐藏状态来解决此问题，从而允许循环阶段同时运行。然而，在我们的实验中，原始配方并不能始终保持普通循环的质量增益。我们发现，在组合它们之前保留当前令牌嵌入并单独对其和先前令牌隐藏状态进行标准化可以在模型规模和训练预算上恢复强大的性能。总之，这些结果表明有效的循环需要将设计与资源约束和推理设置相匹配。

papers.title: Rimuru: Unified Memory Management for Modern LLM Serving via Elastic Expert Offloading
papers.summary: Modern LLMs strain device memory through large model weights and attention states, particularly in resource-constrained scenarios. Existing systems separately provision memory for model weights and attention states, imposing fixed fixed boundaries that cannot adapt to the changing memory demands of workloads. Under heavy workloads, insufficient state capacity limits request concurrency and reduces throughput; under light workloads, idle memory in one region cannot be reallocated to another, wasting device memory. Meanwhile, modern LLM architectures introduce heterogeneous tensors with diverse layouts and lifetimes, further complicating memory management. These problems motivate unified memory management for heterogeneous tensors. However, a shared pool alone does not make memory directly reusable across tensors with different allocation granularities and execution layouts. This paper presents Rimuru, a modern LLM serving system that unifies memory management through elastic expert offloading. Rimuru establishes a shared page pool to enables elastic memory sharing across heterogeneous tensors. To accommodate different allocation granularities, Rimuru introduces memory views that allow each tensor type to interpret the shared memory space using its own page size and page table. Furthermore, Rimuru combines huge-page alignment with a multi-level page allocator that splits and merges pages, enabling cross-type capacity reuse. A page-table-aware fused MoE kernel directly accesses non-contiguous expert weights, avoiding copy overhead. Building on these mechanisms, Rimuru employs a workload-aware adjuster that dynamically reallocates pages across tensor types according to runtime demands. Implemented on top of vLLM, Rimuru remains compatible with modern LLMs. Evaluations show that Rimuru achieves up to 19.03x baseline throughput and reduces TTFT by 98.1% on average.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方案新颖但证据仍偏宣传化
pros: 统一管理权重与KV状态，直击显存割裂与利用率低的问题
提出memory view与页表感知MoE核，系统设计完整且工程价值高
cons: 摘要中的19.03x吞吐与98.1% TTFT提升异常激进，缺少基线公平性、工作负载覆盖与开销拆解等严谨性信息

papers.title_zh: Rimuru：通过弹性专家卸载实现现代 LLM 服务的统一内存管理
papers.summary_zh: 现代法学硕士通过较大的模型权重和注意力状态对设备内存造成压力，特别是在资源受限的情况下。现有系统分别为模型权重和注意力状态提供内存，强加了固定的边界，无法适应工作负载不断变化的内存需求。大负载下，状态容量不足会限制请求并发，降低吞吐量；在轻负载下，一个区域的空闲内存无法重新分配到另一区域，从而浪费设备内存。同时，现代 LLM 架构引入了具有不同布局和生命周期的异构张量，使内存管理进一步复杂化。这些问题促使异构张量的统一内存管理。然而，单独的共享池并不能让内存在具有不同分配粒度和执行布局的张量之间直接重用。本文介绍了 Rimuru，一种现代 LLM 服务系统，通过弹性专家卸载来统一内存管理。 Rimuru 建立了一个共享页面池，以实现跨异构张量的弹性内存共享。为了适应不同的分配粒度，Rimuru 引入了内存视图，允许每种张量类型使用自己的页面大小和页表来解释共享内存空间。此外，Rimuru 将大页对齐与多级页面分配器相结合，可拆分和合并页面，从而实现跨类型的容量重用。页表感知融合 MoE 内核直接访问非连续的专家权重，避免了复制开销。在这些机制的基础上，Rimuru 采用了一个工作负载感知调整器，可以根据运行时需求跨张量类型动态地重新分配页面。 Rimuru 在 vLLM 之上实施，仍然与现代 LLM 兼容。评估显示，Rimuru 实现了高达 19.03 倍基线吞吐量，平均 TTFT 降低了 98.1%。

papers.title: Only Accepted Tokens Count: An Energy Accounting of Speculative Decoding Under Latency Targets
papers.summary: Large language model serving is limited by facility power. Energy per token determines how many tokens a datacenter can serve, while a latency target bounds how quickly each user receives them. During decode, every weight is read from memory for every generated token. Batching amortizes this read across users but makes no individual user faster. Speculative decoding does: a drafter proposes several future tokens, and the target model verifies them in a single forward pass that reuses the same weight read. Because every drafted token must be verified whether or not it is accepted, the energy speculation saves depends on how many drafted tokens are accepted. This saving is hard to pin down. It varies across target models from different attention families and across drafting schemes, and it depends on the text being served. Every drafter we evaluate accepts fewer tokens on conversation than on code, and every trained drafter accepts fewer on Romansh, a low-resource language, than on English. We measure speculative decoding under production serving conditions (SGLang, CUDA graphs enabled) on H100 and H200 GPUs, at batch sizes up to 64 across 5 corpora. On dense models, verification, not drafting, dominates the energy cost. The saving shrinks as the batch grows, because batching has already shared the weight read that speculation would divide among the accepted tokens. At large batch sizes, block drafters push verification past the balance point between arithmetic and memory traffic into the compute-bound regime, where the saving becomes a loss, and a drafter with low acceptance raises energy per token. Meeting a tighter latency target with speculation then costs additional energy. Larger batches lower energy per token without speculation. Speculation adds to that saving only when acceptance is high, and on the model we tested it leaves little headroom for latency-preserving DVFS.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 问题重要、实证扎实，但外推性仍待加强。
pros: 聚焦“仅接受token计收益”的能耗核算，问题定义精准且具有工程现实意义
实验设置贴近生产（SGLang、CUDA Graph、H100/H200、大batch、多语料），结论对部署决策有直接指导价值
cons: 当前主要基于特定模型与硬件平台，跨架构与跨系统的普适性证据仍不足

papers.title_zh: 仅接受的令牌才算数：延迟目标下推测解码的能量核算
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型服务受到设施能力的限制。每个代币的能量决定了数据中心可以服务的代币数量，而延迟目标则限制了每个用户接收代币的速度。在解码期间，从存储器中读取每个生成的令牌的每个权重。批处理会在用户之间分摊此读取，但不会使单个用户更快。推测解码的作用是：起草者提出几个未来的令牌，目标模型在重复使用相同权重读取的单个前向传递中验证它们。因为每个起草的代币都必须验证是否被接受，所以节省的能源投机取决于有多少起草的代币被接受。这种节省很难确定。它因来自不同注意力系列的目标模型和起草方案而异，并且取决于所提供的文本。我们评估的每个起草者在对话中接受的标记都少于在代码中接受的标记，并且每个经过培训的起草者在罗曼什语（一种资源匮乏的语言）上接受的标记比在英语上接受的标记少。我们在 H100 和 H200 GPU 上测量生产服务条件（SGLang、启用 CUDA 图）下的推测解码，在 5 个语料库中批量大小高达 64。在密集模型中，验证（而不是起草）主导着能源成本。随着批次的增长，节省的空间会减少，因为批次已经共享了猜测将在接受的令牌之间划分的权重读取。在大批量情况下，区块起草者将验证推向算术和内存流量之间的平衡点，进入计算限制状态，在这种情况下，节省变成了损失，而接受度较低的起草者会提高每个代币的能量。通过推测来满足更严格的延迟目标会消耗额外的能量。批量越大，每个代币的能量就越低，无需投机。仅当接受度很高时，推测才会增加节省，并且在我们测试的模型上，它为保留延迟的 DVFS 留下了很少的空间。

papers.title: Low-Bit GDN Recurrent-State Quantization: Global Gradient-aware Allocation and Pure-Write Sliding Windows
papers.summary: Linear attention stores historical information in a recurrent state of fixed size, providing a compact memory representation for long-context inference. Reducing state precision further lowers per-request storage requirements, but quantized writeback errors enter subsequent recurrences, degrade prediction quality on long-reasoning tasks, and can be accompanied by repetitive generation and excessively long outputs. We propose Global Gradient-aware Allocation (GGA) and the Pure-Write Sliding Window (PW) to address precision allocation and recent-information maintenance. GGA combines candidate quantization residuals with gradient sensitivity to future prediction loss to allocate head bit widths under a model-wide mixed-precision budget. PW independently maintains recent pure writes as FP8 vector pairs, propagates them through the full GDN state transition, and merges them into the low-bit historical state only after they leave the window. Across seven evaluations on Qwen3.5-4B/9B, GGA allocation alone improves over STEPQuant@4 by 19.48/29.84 percentage points. Adding PW-S8 yields seven-task macro-averages of 69.83%/78.63%, improving over STEPQuant@4 by 38.39/41.21 percentage points, respectively. Both precision reallocation and window maintenance improve task scores while mitigating excessively long outputs: at @6, GGA reduces mean generation length, averaged equally across tasks, by 10.45%/14.65% relative to STEPQuant; adding PW-S8 to GGA@4 further reduces mean generation length by 32.32%/36.77%. Comparisons at similar storage budgets further show that using additional capacity to maintain recent writes yields higher task scores and shorter mean outputs than solely increasing the bit width of the accumulated state.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 面向长上下文推理的实用改进，潜力较强
pros: 针对低比特循环状态误差累积提出GGA+PW联合方案，问题定义与方法对应清晰
在两种模型与七项评测上报告了较大增益，并兼顾精度与生成长度稳定性
cons: 摘要缺少统计显著性、开销分解与更广泛强基线对比，结论稳健性仍需正文验证

papers.title_zh: 低位 GDN 循环状态量化：全局梯度感知分配和纯写滑动窗口
papers.summary_zh: 线性注意力以固定大小的循环状态存储历史信息，为长上下文推理提供紧凑的内存表示。降低状态精度进一步降低了每个请求的存储要求，但量化写回错误会进入后续循环，降低长推理任务的预测质量，并且可能伴随重复生成和过长的输出。我们提出全局梯度感知分配（GGA）和纯写滑动窗口（PW）来解决精确分配和最新信息维护问题。 GGA 将候选量化残差与对未来预测损失的梯度敏感性相结合，以在模型范围的混合精度预算下分配头位宽度。 PW 独立地将最近的纯写入维护为 FP8 向量对，通过完整的 GDN 状态转换传播它们，并仅在它们离开窗口后将它们合并到低位历史状态。在 Qwen3.5-4B/9B 的七次评估中，仅 GGA 分配就比 STEPQuant@4 提高了 19.48/29.84 个百分点。添加 PW-S8 的七任务宏平均值为 69.83%/78.63%，比 STEPQuant@4 分别提高了 38.39/41.21 个百分点。精度重新分配和窗口维护都提高了任务分数，同时减轻了过长的输出：在 @6 时，GGA 相对于 STEPQuant 减少了平均生成长度（跨任务平均）10.45%/14.65%；将 PW-S8 添加到 GGA@4 中，平均世代长度进一步减少了 32.32%/36.77%。类似存储预算的比较进一步表明，与仅增加累积状态的位宽度相比，使用额外的容量来维护最近的写入会产生更高的任务分数和更短的平均输出。

papers.title: KV Cache Quantization for Diffusion Language Models
papers.summary: KV cache quantization is well studied for autoregressive language models, where cached prefix states are exact under causal attention and quantization is mainly a cache reconstruction problem. Diffusion language models (dLLMs) break this assumption. Fast dLLM inference reuses KV states across denoising steps, but bidirectional token representations can change as masked tokens are revealed, so the reused cache may already differ from full recomputation before quantization is applied. We study KV cache quantization under this cache-reuse error. We adapt KIVI and KVQuant to Fast-dLLM-style prefix and dual cache reuse, and introduce TRACE and dLLM-KVQ. TRACE reconstructs feasible dLLM reveal trajectories from prompt-answer pairs, providing calibration states that match iterative masked decoding. dLLM-KVQ uses these trajectories to choose per-layer K-cache entries that remain in high precision according to output- and attention-level behavior metrics, while applying standard low-bit value quantization. Across LLaDA and Dream evaluations on GSM8K, HumanEval, MATH, and MBPP, dLLM-KVQ achieves the highest average score among quantized methods across the reported 4-bit and 2-bit prefix/dual cache settings.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题定义新颖且实用，但证据深度仍有限。
pros: 明确指出dLLM缓存复用误差与AR场景本质差异，问题切中痛点
提出TRACE与分层保精策略，兼顾可实现性与跨任务实证表现
cons: 摘要未体现统计显著性、开销拆解与更广基线对比，严谨性仍待加强

papers.title_zh: 扩散语言模型的 KV 缓存量化
papers.summary_zh: KV 缓存量化在自回归语言模型中得到了很好的研究，其中缓存的前缀状态在因果注意下是准确的，并且量化主要是缓存重建问题。扩散语言模型 (dLLM) 打破了这一假设。快速 dLLM 推理在去噪步骤中重用 KV 状态，但双向令牌表示可能会随着屏蔽令牌的显示而改变，因此重用的缓存可能已经与应用量化之前的完全重新计算不同。我们研究了这种缓存重用错误下的 KV 缓存量化。我们将 KIVI 和 KVQuant 应用于 Fast-dLLM 式前缀和双缓存重用，并引入 TRACE 和 dLLM-KVQ。 TRACE 重建可行的 dLLM，揭示来自提示答案对的轨迹，提供与迭代屏蔽解码相匹配的校准状态。 dLLM-KVQ 使用这些轨迹来选择每层 K 缓存条目，这些条目根据输出和注意力级别的行为指标保持高精度，同时应用标准的低位值量化。在 GSM8K、HumanEval、MATH 和 MBPP 上的 LLaDA 和 Dream 评估中，dLLM-KVQ 在报告的 4 位和 2 位前缀/双缓存设置的量化方法中获得了最高的平均得分。

papers.title: DWISE: Denoising Workload-Informed Scheduling Engine
papers.summary: Unlike autoregressive large language models (AR-LLMs), diffusion LLMs (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising many tokens in parallel, offering a promising path to efficient inference. Existing serving frameworks, however, schedule dLLM requests with policies designed for AR models, namely first-come-first-served (FCFS) admission and prefill priority. We find that both policies are ill-suited to dLLMs, wasting much of their speed. FCFS ignores that a dLLM request's decoding cost is highly heterogeneous and unknown at arrival, causing severe head-of-line blocking. Prefill priority, widely used in AR-LLM serving to keep time-to-first-token low, sharply cuts dLLM efficiency, as rounds that run only prompts leave most of the batch idle. We present DWISE, a Denoising Workload-Informed Scheduling Engine for efficient dLLM serving. DWISE schedules requests by their remaining work, measured in a block-level unit shared by prefill and denoising, so both phases share a round. To predict the unknown denoising workload, DWISE combines a lightweight prompt-based predictor at admission with a single refinement from the first denoising round's hidden states, which capture model-specific information absent from the prompt and require no additional model execution. Implemented in SGLang and evaluated on five models from three dLLM families under bursty workloads, DWISE reduces mean end-to-end latency over SGLang by 5.4$\times$ on average and up to 14.9$\times$ while preserving task accuracy. The code will be released publicly.

papers.title_zh: DWISE：去噪工作负载通知调度引擎
papers.summary_zh: 与自回归大型语言模型 (AR-LLM) 不同，扩散 LLM (dLLM) 通过并行迭代地对许多标记进行去噪来生成文本，为高效推理提供了一条有希望的途径。然而，现有的服务框架使用专为 AR 模型设计的策略来安排 dLLM 请求，即先到先服务 (FCFS) 准入和预填充优先级。我们发现这两项政策都不适合 dLLM，浪费了他们的大部分速度。 FCFS 忽略了 dLLM 请求的解码成本在到达时是高度异构且未知的，从而导致严重的队头阻塞。预填充优先级广泛用于 AR-LLM 服务，以保持较低的首次令牌时间，但会大幅降低 dLLM 效率，因为仅运行提示的轮次会使大部分批次闲置。我们推出 DWISE，这是一种基于去噪工作负载的调度引擎，可实现高效的 dLLM 服务。 DWISE 通过剩余工作来安排请求，以预填充和去噪共享的块级单元来衡量，因此两个阶段共享一轮。为了预测未知的去噪工作负载，DWISE 在准入时将基于提示的轻量级预测器与第一轮去噪的隐藏状态的单一细化相结合，捕获提示中缺少的特定于模型的信息，并且不需要额外的模型执行。 DWISE 在 SGLang 中实施，并在突发工作负载下对来自三个 dLLM 系列的五个模型进行了评估，与 SGLang 相比，平均端到端延迟平均降低了 5.4$\times$，最高可达 14.9$\times$，同时保持任务准确性。该代码将公开发布。

papers.title: Category-Anchored Large Language Models for Next POI Recommendation
papers.summary: Next point-of-interest (POI) recommendation aims to predict a user's next destination from spatio-temporal check-in data, and serves as the foundation for many location-based services. Recent advances incorporate large language models (LLMs) into this task by textualizing user trajectories to exploit their semantic reasoning ability. However, directly generating POI identifiers with such models is unreliable: POIs are sparse, localized, and long-tailed entities with weak natural-language semantics, which creates a semantic-to-entity gap between high-level mobility intent and concrete POI prediction. To bridge this gap, we propose ANCHOR, a category-anchored framework for semantic-to-entity grounding in next POI recommendation. Specifically, ANCHOR first estimates category-level mobility intent in a compact and stable semantic space, rather than predicting concrete POI entities directly. The inferred intent is then grounded into a candidate set by integrating three complementary sources of mobility evidence: category anchors, historical visit memory, and user preferences. Finally, a history-aware reranker selects the target POI by matching each candidate with the user's historical mobility patterns and current context. Experiments on three real-world check-in datasets show that ANCHOR consistently outperforms representative traditional, structure-enhanced, and LLM-based baselines on the reported metrics. Further analyses validate the effectiveness of semantic-to-entity grounding and show favorable trade-offs among candidate coverage, ranking quality, and inference efficiency.
papers.comment: Accepted by the 43rd IEEE International Conference on Data Engineering (ICDE 2027)

papers.title_zh: 用于下一个 POI 推荐的类别锚定大型语言模型
papers.summary_zh: 下一个兴趣点 (POI) 推荐旨在根据时空签到数据预测用户的下一个目的地，并作为许多基于位置的服务的基础。最近的进展通过将用户轨迹文本化以利用他们的语义推理能力，将大型语言模型（LLM）纳入到这项任务中。然而，使用此类模型直接生成 POI 标识符并不可靠：POI 是稀疏、本地化和长尾的实体，自然语言语义较弱，这在高级移动意图和具体 POI 预测之间造成了语义与实体之间的差距。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了 ANCHOR，这是一种类别锚定框架，用于在下一个 POI 推荐中实现语义到实体的基础。具体来说，ANCHOR 首先在紧凑且稳定的语义空间中估计类别级别的移动意图，而不是直接预测具体的 POI 实体。然后，通过整合三个互补的移动性证据来源（类别锚、历史访问记忆和用户偏好），将推断出的意图扎根到候选集中。最后，历史感知重排序器通过将每个候选 POI 与用户的历史移动模式和当前上下文进行匹配来选择目标 POI。对三个真实世界签到数据集的实验表明，ANCHOR 在报告的指标上始终优于代表性的传统、结构增强和基于 LLM 的基线。进一步的分析验证了语义到实体基础的有效性，并显示了候选覆盖范围、排名质量和推理效率之间的有利权衡。

papers.title: Unlocking Any-Order Generation in Pretrained Autoregressive Image Models
papers.summary: Autoregressive (AR) image generators are powerful in principle but inflexible in practice: training with a fixed raster-scan order hardcodes a single factorization of the image distribution into the model, leaving it unable to inpaint, outpaint, or edit at inference time. Existing solutions, including the modern discrete-diffusion family, train from scratch on a mixture of token orderings, paying roughly 3x the compute of standard raster-scan training; discrete diffusion further sacrifices compatibility with the AR inference ecosystem (KV caching, vLLM) by construction. We argue that this cost is unnecessary. A pretrained raster-scan AR model has already learned the joint distribution over image tokens; what it lacks is not knowledge but the ability to express that knowledge through non-sequential conditional pathways. We propose a recipe for adapting pretrained raster-scan models into any-order generators using two components: future-aware positional embeddings that resolve a target-position identifiability problem at negligible overhead, and an ordering curriculum that traces a stable optimization path from the pretrained solution to a good any-order basin. Applied to four base models across two architectures and two scales (LlamaGen-L/XL, RAR-L/XL), the recipe substantially outperforms MaskGIT on ImageNet inpainting (FID 6.21 vs. 10.44) and outpainting, is competitive with MAR-L, trades a 1.2-1.9 increase in class-conditional FID for this flexibility, and costs 13-33% additional compute beyond pretraining, while leaving the standard AR inference stack untouched. Inpainting, outpainting, and editing, our results suggest, need not be added to autoregressive image models. They can be unlocked from the ones that exist. Code is available at https://github.com/Ordered-AR/unlockedadaptation.
papers.comment: Accepted in NeurIPS 2026, Sydney as a poster

papers.title_zh: 解锁预训练自回归图像模型中的任意阶生成
papers.summary_zh: 自回归 (AR) 图像生成器原则上功能强大，但在实践中缺乏灵活性：使用固定光栅扫描顺序进行训练将图像分布的单个因式分解硬编码到模型中，使其无法在推理时进行修复、覆盖或编辑。现有的解决方案，包括现代离散扩散系列，从头开始对令牌排序的混合进行训练，花费的计算量大约是标准光栅扫描训练的 3 倍；离散扩散通过构建进一步牺牲了与 AR 推理生态系统（KV 缓存、vLLM）的兼容性。我们认为这个成本是不必要的。预训练的光栅扫描 AR 模型已经学习了图像标记上的联合分布；它缺乏的不是知识，而是通过非顺序条件路径表达知识的能力。我们提出了一种方法，使用两个组件将预训练的光栅扫描模型调整为任意阶生成器：未来感知的位置嵌入，以可忽略的开销解决目标位置可识别性问题，以及排序课程，跟踪从预训练的解决方案到良好的任意阶盆地的稳定优化路径。应用于两种架构和两种规模（LlamaGen-L/XL、RAR-L/XL）的四个基本模型时，该方法在 ImageNet 修复（FID 6.21 与 10.44）和修复方面大大优于 MaskGIT，与 MAR-L 具有竞争力，以类条件 FID 增加 1.2-1.9 倍来换取这种灵活性，并且在预训练之外花费 13-33% 的额外计算成本，而标准 AR 推理堆栈保持不变。我们的结果表明，修复、修复和编辑不需要添加到自回归图像模型中。它们可以从现有的中解锁。代码可在 https://github.com/Ordered-AR/unlockedadaptation 获取。

papers.title: Why Speculative Decoding Works Better Than Predicted on Sparse MoE Models
papers.summary: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates autoregressive inference by leveraging the memory bound nature of decoding, verifying multiple draft tokens in a single forward pass. For mixture-of-experts (MoE) models, prior work predicts a concave speedup-batch size relationship, with gains peaking at intermediate batch sizes due to expert saturation. We evaluate this across 10 sparse MoE models (30B--1T parameters, 8--512 experts) and find recent fine-grained models break this trend, showing higher speedup at low batch size. We find verification cost is governed not only by activated-expert bytes, but also by temporal overlap across draft tokens and GPU execution dynamics. At low batch size, MoE layers in fine-grained models account for a much smaller share of runtime than of weights; on H100, kernel profiling attributes this mainly to higher bandwidth utilization of MoE kernels relative to attention, with L2 absorbing repeated reads of co-routed experts. Across draft tokens, routing overlap further reduces the unique experts activated during verification relative to independence assumptions. We model this effect using a maximum-entropy Iterative Proportional Fitting (IPF) framework that predicts unique expert counts from routing-overlap statistics with less than 4\% error, and substantially narrows the gap to real-model curves and captures the qualitative low-batch trend from synthetic routing.
papers.comment: Accepted as at NeurIPS 2026 main track conference

papers.title_zh: 为什么推测解码在稀疏 MoE 模型上比预测的效果更好
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码 (SD) 通过利用解码的内存限制性质，在单次前向传递中验证多个草稿令牌，加速自回归推理。对于专家混合 (MoE) 模型，先前的工作预测了凹加速-批量大小关系，由于专家饱和，增益在中间批量大小处达到峰值。我们对 10 个稀疏 MoE 模型（30B--1T 参数，8--512 名专家）进行了评估，发现最近的细粒度模型打破了这一趋势，在低批量大小下表现出更高的加速。我们发现验证成本不仅受激活专家字节的影响，还受草稿令牌和 GPU 执行动态之间的时间重叠的影响。在小批量大小下，细粒度模型中的 MoE 层所占的运行时间份额比权重要小得多；在 H100 上，内核分析将这主要归因于 MoE 内核相对于注意力的更高带宽利用率，L2 吸收了共同路由专家的重复读取。在草案代币中，相对于独立性假设，路由重叠进一步减少了验证期间激活的独特专家。我们使用最大熵迭代比例拟合 (IPF) 框架对这种效果进行建模，该框架根据路由重叠统计数据预测独特的专家计数，误差小于 4%，并大幅缩小与真实模型曲线的差距，并从合成路由中捕获定性低批量趋势。

papers.title: Context Compaction for World Models
papers.summary: World models let observers explore and interact with generated worlds. Recent work shows that when observers revisit a region, current models often fail to regenerate it consistently. We view this as a context retrieval problem. LLM agents manage context retrieval at two layers of their stack. At the model layer, the KV cache design determines how much context fits in memory. At the agent harness layer, harnesses such as Claude Code pick the context sent to the LLM. Prior work on world models has mostly focused only on the model layer. In this paper, we make three contributions. First, we build a benchmark to measure world model context retrieval. It generates new worlds for every episode, preventing a model from recalling rooms using training data. It also separates context retrieval from guesses based on nearby frames. Second, we build an agent harness that performs context compaction for world models, which to our knowledge no prior work has studied. Third, we use our benchmark to study four world model designs. Context compaction lets our world models retrieve rooms up to 4 times beyond their context window without retraining. However, world models with sliding-window attention lose most of their context retrieval when dreaming. Therefore, a dreaming world agent benefits more from extending the reach of its world model using context compaction than switching to sliding window attention at the model layer.

papers.title_zh: 世界模型的上下文压缩
papers.summary_zh: 世界模型让观察者可以探索生成的世界并与之交互。最近的研究表明，当观察者重新访问一个区域时，当前的模型通常无法一致地重新生成它。我们将此视为上下文检索问题。 LLM 代理在其堆栈的两层管理上下文检索。在模型层，KV 缓存设计决定了内存中适合多少上下文。在代理工具层，Claude Code 等工具会选择发送到 LLM 的上下文。之前关于世界模型的工作主要只关注模型层。在本文中，我们做出了三项贡献。首先，我们建立一个基准来衡量世界模型上下文检索。它为每一集生成新的世界，防止模型使用训练数据回忆房间。它还将上下文检索与基于附近帧的猜测分开。其次，我们构建了一个代理工具，可以对世界模型执行上下文压缩，据我们所知，之前的工作还没有研究过这一点。第三，我们使用我们的基准来研究四种世界模型设计。上下文压缩让我们的世界模型能够检索超出上下文窗口 4 倍的房间，而无需重新训练。然而，具有滑动窗口注意力的世界模型在做梦时会失去大部分上下文检索。因此，与在模型层切换到滑动窗口注意力相比，梦想世界智能体从使用上下文压缩扩展其世界模型的范围中获益更多。

papers.title: TableTune: Measured, Self-Correcting Draft-Length Tables for Dynamic Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Speculative decoding speeds up large language model (LLM) serving only while the GPU has spare compute, so the best draft length, the number of tokens a small drafter guesses per step, shrinks as the batch grows. vLLM lets operators set the draft length for each batch size with a hand-written table, but nothing measures or corrects that table. We present TableTune. Its tuner times the decoding step for every batch size and draft length on vLLM's own serving path and computes, in minutes, the table that maximizes throughput. Its controller, a vLLM plugin, tracks how many guesses are accepted in live traffic and rebuilds the table while serving. We measure TableTune only against other ways to speculate. On an H100, the tuned table delivers at least 94% of the throughput of the best fixed draft length at every load in four of five drafter settings (88% in the fifth) without the operator having to know which length that is. Against reimplementations of TurboSpec- and Nightjar-style control on the same engine, its worst-case loss is never higher than theirs, and with the EAGLE-3 drafter it is 3% against 9% and 12%. On a mixture-of-experts model, vLLM's documented table loses up to 18% and the tuned table at most 3%. Starting from mistuned tables, the controller raises throughput by up to 58% (up to 45% on vLLM's default runner), and after a workload switch with the DFlash drafter it recovers 96% of a stale table's loss. In llm-d's optimized-baseline deployment as shipped, two Qwen3-32B replicas on four GPUs, the tuned table is up to 32% faster than a fixed draft length of 3 and up to 25% faster than vLLM's documented table at high load, and the controller raises the documented table's throughput by up to 29%.

papers.title_zh: TableTune：用于动态推测解码的测量自校正草稿长度表
papers.summary_zh: 仅当 GPU 有空闲计算时，推测性解码才能加速大型语言模型 (LLM) 服务，因此最佳草稿长度（小型起草者每步猜测的标记数量）会随着批次的增长而缩小。 vLLM 允许操作员使用手写表格设置每个批次大小的草稿长度，但没有任何措施或纠正该表格。我们推出 TableTune。它的调谐器在 vLLM 自己的服务路径上为每个批量大小和草稿长度计算解码步骤，并在几分钟内计算出最大化吞吐量的表。它的控制器是一个 vLLM 插件，跟踪实时流量中接受的猜测数量，并在服务时重建表。我们仅根据其他推测方式来衡量 TableTune。在 H100 上，调谐台在五种牵伸器设置中的四种（第五种为 88%）中的每种负载下提供最佳固定牵伸长度吞吐量的至少 94%，而操作员无需知道具体长度。相对于在同一台发动机上重新实现 TurboSpec 和 Nightjar 式控制，其最坏情况下的损失永远不会高于它们的损失，而使用 EAGLE-3 牵伸机时，其损失为 3%、9% 和 12%。在专家混合模型上，vLLM 的记录表损失高达 18%，而调整表最多损失 3%。从错误调整的表开始，控制器将吞吐量提高了高达 58%（在 vLLM 的默认运行器上高达 45%），并且在使用 DFlash 起草器进行工作负载切换后，它恢复了过时表损失的 96%。在 llm-d 出厂时的优化基线部署中，四个 GPU 上有两个 Qwen3-32B 副本，调整后的表比固定草稿长度 3 快 32%，比高负载下 vLLM 的记录表快 25%，并且控制器将记录表的吞吐量提高了 29%。

papers.title: FlatCake: A Flat KVCache Storage Architecture for LLM Serving
papers.summary: KV cache reuse accelerates LLM serving, but existing systems manage host DRAM and NVMe SSD as a tiered hierarchy where DRAM acts as an intermediate cache. Production LLM workloads break both premises of this hierarchy. First, bimodal reuse defeats DRAM temporal filtering, since workloads are dominated either by one-shot blocks with long reuse distances or by multi-gigabyte agentic sessions that exceed DRAM capacity, putting SSD on the critical read path. Second, DRAM staging and eviction-ordered layout bottleneck SSD restoration. Holding host staging buffers for in-flight prefixes causes contention under load that aborts prefetches, while incremental eviction scatters a session's blocks across the SSD and prevents large sequential reads. We present FlatCake, a flat KV storage architecture that exposes host DRAM and NVMe SSD as peer media in a unified 64-bit address space. Exploiting the fact that KV blocks are write-once, immutable, and reused at session scope, FlatCake places each block directly onto its target medium in session-contiguous, layer-major order at creation time and never migrates it. FlatCake streams coalesced SSD reads directly into a bounded GPU window via GPUDirect Storage and decouples DRAM and SSD request queues to prevent head-of-line blocking. On a production Claude Code trace with DeepSeek-V4-Flash, FlatCake sustains a 94% cache hit rate as load increases (versus 64% for Mooncake), eliminates Mooncake's $6.5\times$--$6.7\times$ SSD read amplification, and reduces peak-load mean TTFT by $1.6\times$ while improving total token throughput by $1.6\times$. Across 8K--128K contexts on Llama-3.1-70B, FlatCake further reduces mean TTFT by up to $2.4\times$ over Mooncake and $1.8\times$ over Mooncake-GDS.

系统设计与实现细节完整，端到端收益在真实生产轨迹上较显著

结论依赖特定工作负载与硬件栈，通用性和可复现性风险未完全消除

papers.title_zh: FlatCake：用于 LLM 服务的扁平 KVCache 存储架构
papers.summary_zh: KV 缓存重用可加速 LLM 服务，但现有系统将主机 DRAM 和 NVMe SSD 作为分层结构进行管理，其中 DRAM 充当中间缓存。生产 LLM 工作负载打破了这种层次结构的两个前提。首先，双模式重用击败了 DRAM 时间过滤，因为工作负载要么由具有长重用距离的一次性块主导，要么由超过 DRAM 容量的多 GB 代理会话主导，从而将 SSD 置于关键读取路径上。其次，DRAM 分级和驱逐顺序布局瓶颈 SSD 恢复。为运行中的前缀保留主机暂存缓冲区会导致负载下的争用，从而中止预取，而增量逐出会将会话的块分散在 SSD 上并阻止大量顺序读取。我们推出了 FlatCake，这是一种扁平 KV 存储架构，它将主机 DRAM 和 NVMe SSD 作为统一的 64 位地址空间中的对等介质公开。利用 KV 块一次性写入、不可变且在会话范围内重用的事实，FlatCake 在创建时以会话连续、层主顺序将每个块直接放置到其目标介质上，并且从不迁移它。 FlatCake 通过 GPUDirect Storage 将合并的 SSD 读取直接流式传输到有界 GPU 窗口中，并解耦 DRAM 和 SSD 请求队列以防止队头阻塞。在使用 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 的生产 Claude 代码跟踪中，随着负载增加，FlatCake 维持了 94% 的缓存命中率（而 Mooncake 为 64%），消除了 Mooncake 的 $6.5\times$--$6.7\times$ SSD 读取放大，并将峰值负载平均 TTFT 降低了 $1.6\times$，同时将总令牌吞吐量提高了 $1.6\times$。在 Llama-3.1-70B 上的 8K--128K 上下文中，FlatCake 比 Mooncake 进一步降低了平均 TTFT 高达 2.4\times$，比 Mooncake-GDS 降低了 1.8\times$。

papers.title: Multi-Token Prediction Done Right
papers.summary: Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) is now a common ingredient in language-model pre-training, as it improves downstream performance and enables faster inference through speculative decoding. We identify a flaw in standard MTP training, in which a residual component of the MTP gradient interferes with both next-token and multi-token learning, increasingly so with scale. Specifically, the MTP cross-entropy gradient can be decomposed exactly into a KL self-distillation term that pulls each MTP head toward the model's own next-token prediction (NTP) distribution and improves speculative decoding, and a residual that has a low signal-to-noise ratio and buries the useful KL signal. We introduce the KL gradient-recovery trick: when two distributions share a linear output head, the gradient of their KL divergence can be recovered exactly by combining their cross-entropy gradients through straight-through gradient routing. Unlike minimizing the KL directly, this trick requires no vocabulary-sized logit matrices and is compatible with standard fused cross-entropy kernels. This enables Soft Multi-Token Prediction (Soft-MTP), a one-line code change to MTP that removes the noisy residual and backpropagates only the KL self-distillation signal by reusing the existing NTP and MTP cross-entropy computations. Soft-MTP supports both DeepSeek- and Meta-style MTP, adds no parameters, and incurs no measurable overhead. From 167M to 1.2B parameters, Soft-MTP improves over standard MTP with lower NTP perplexity, faster speculative decoding and higher zero-shot accuracy at every scale, lower MTP perplexity from 689M onward, and stronger math and code reasoning after fine-tuning at 1.2B. Soft-MTP also matches, if not exceeds, direct KL divergence minimization on most metrics. Soft-MTP is, in effect, a free lunch for MTP optimization. Our code can be found at https://github.com/JaydenTeoh/Soft-MTP.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但泛化证据仍需更强。
pros: 提出将MTP梯度精确分解并恢复KL有效梯度，机制解释清晰且有理论味道
方法工程代价极低（近一行改动、无额外参数/开销）且在多尺度报告了稳定收益
cons: 证据主要来自中小规模（至1.2B）与特定设置，缺少更大模型、更多数据配方及长程下游任务的独立验证

papers.title_zh: 正确完成多令牌预测
papers.summary_zh: 多标记预测 (MTP) 现在是语言模型预训练中的常见成分，因为它提高了下游性能并通过推测解码实现更快的推理。我们发现了标准 MTP 训练中的一个缺陷，其中 MTP 梯度的残余分量会干扰下一个令牌和多令牌学习，并且随着规模的增加，这种情况越来越严重。具体来说，MTP 交叉熵梯度可以精确地分解为 KL 自蒸馏项，该项将每个 MTP 头拉向模型自己的下一个令牌预测 (NTP) 分布并改进推测解码，以及具有低信噪比并掩盖有用 KL 信号的残差。我们介绍了 KL 梯度恢复技巧：当两个分布共享一个线性输出头时，可以通过直通梯度路由组合它们的交叉熵梯度来精确恢复它们的 KL 散度的梯度。与直接最小化 KL 不同，此技巧不需要词汇大小的 Logit 矩阵，并且与标准融合交叉熵内核兼容。这使得软多令牌预测（Soft-MTP）成为可能，这是对 MTP 的一行代码更改，通过重用现有的 NTP 和 MTP 交叉熵计算来消除噪声残差并仅反向传播 KL 自蒸馏信号。 Soft-MTP 支持 DeepSeek 和 Meta 风格的 MTP，不添加任何参数，并且不会产生可测量的开销。从 167M 到 1.2B 参数，Soft-MTP 相对于标准 MTP 进行了改进，具有更低的 NTP 困惑度、更快的推测解码和更高的每个尺度的零样本精度、从 689M 开始更低的 MTP 困惑度以及在 1.2B 微调后更强的数学和代码推理。 Soft-MTP 在大多数指标上也匹配（如果不是超过的话）直接 KL 散度最小化。Soft-MTP 实际上是 MTP 优化的免费午餐。我们的代码可以在 https://github.com/JaydenTeoh/Soft-MTP 找到。

papers.title: LLM-PowerTrace: A Dataset of Time-Resolved GPU Power Traces for AI Compute
papers.summary: AI compute is becoming large and fast-changing electrical loads. Its impacts on data center infrastructure and power grids depend not only on total energy consumption, but also on how their power draw moves over sub-second to minute timescales, including peaks, ramps, and synchronized fluctuations across accelerators. Existing energy benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) report aggregate quantities such as joules per token and rarely release the underlying time-series measurements, leaving these power dynamics poorly characterized and difficult to model. We introduce LLM-PowerTrace, an open dataset of time-resolved, per-GPU power traces for LLM fine-tuning and inference, sampled every 100\,ms on varying NVIDIA platforms paired with complete workload and system metadata. For fine-tuning, LLM-PowerTrace profiles open model families spanning a wide range of model sizes and fine-tuning methods, together with controlled sweeps over batch size, sequence length, precision, parallelism, and checkpointing. For inference, it covers variations in concurrency, GPU frequency, KV-cache and weight quantization, prompt and output lengths, and request-arrival patterns. LLM-PowerTrace profiles a set of open model families across a wide range of model sizes, and controlled sweeps over batch size, sequence length, precision, parallelism, and checkpointing for fine-tuning, and it sweeps concurrency, GPU frequency, KV cache and weight quantization, prompt and output lengths, and request arrival patterns for inference. Built upon power traces, we define power-grid-facing metrics as well as AI-compute power\&energy scaling law for extrapolating beyond the measured settings. Together, LLM-PowerTrace provides a dataset foundation for modeling, forecasting, and managing the fast-changing electrical behavior of AI compute.
papers.comment: In Submission; Code and dataset are available at https://systems-power-review.github.io/training-power-trace-explorer/

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 选题重要且数据有价值，但方法严谨性仍待验证。
pros: 聚焦100ms级时序功率，补齐现有仅汇总能耗指标的关键空白
覆盖训练与推理多维控制变量，且提供较完整元数据，复用潜力高
cons: 仅从摘要看缺少测量校准与误差分析细节，数据可信度边界不清
平台以NVIDIA为主，跨硬件与跨数据中心泛化性可能受限

papers.title_zh: LLM-PowerTrace：用于 AI 计算的时间分辨 GPU 功率跟踪数据集
papers.summary_zh: 人工智能计算正在变得庞大且快速变化的电力负载。它对数据中心基础设施和电网的影响不仅取决于总能耗，还取决于其功耗在亚秒到分钟时间尺度内的变化情况，包括峰值、斜坡和加速器之间的同步波动。大型语言模型 (LLM) 的现有能源基准报告了每个代币的焦耳等总量，并且很少发布底层时间序列测量结果，导致这些电力动态特征难以表征且难以建模。我们推出了 LLM-PowerTrace，这是一个用于 LLM 微调和推理的时间解析、每 GPU 功率跟踪的开放数据集，在不同的 NVIDIA 平台上每 100 毫秒采样一次，并配有完整的工作负载和系统元数据。对于微调，LLM-PowerTrace 提供了涵盖各种模型大小和微调方法的开放模型系列，以及对批量大小、序列长度、精度、并行性和检查点的受控扫描。对于推理，它涵盖了并发性、GPU 频率、KV 缓存和权重量化、提示和输出长度以及请求到达模式的变化。 LLM-PowerTrace 分析了一系列跨各种模型大小的开放模型系列，并对批量大小、序列长度、精度、并行性和检查点进行受控扫描以进行微调，并扫描并发性、GPU 频率、KV 缓存和权重量化、提示和输出长度以及用于推理的请求到达模式。基于功率轨迹，我们定义了面向电网的指标以及人工智能计算功率\和能量缩放定律，以进行超出测量设置的推断。LLM-PowerTrace 共同为建模、预测和管理 AI 计算快速变化的电气行为提供了数据集基础。

papers.title: GAAC: Lossless KV Compression for Bandwidth-Efficient LLM Inference on Personal Devices
papers.summary: Weight-only, lossy quantization substantially reduces the storage and memory requirements for serving large language models (LLMs), but the growing key-value (KV) cache remains a bottleneck for long-context inference on personal devices. We present Group-Adaptive Additive Codec (GAAC), a lossless KV compression and serving system that exploits exponent redundancy to reduce storage and accelerate attention without introducing KV approximation. GAAC encodes BF16 exponents using calibrated per-channel base-plus-offset codes over contiguous ranges. GAAC adapts code widths across small groups while preserving KV values bit-for-bit. A fused attention kernel reconstructs KV tiles on the fly, avoiding full-cache decompression. Block-wise compression and fixed-capacity slots support incremental cache updates and paged serving. Across five tested models, GAAC achieves 1.405-1.407$\times$ lossless BF16 KV compression. We also study compression performance on low-precision tensors FP8 E4M3 caches ( 1.09-1.14$\times$) and E5M2 caches (1.25-1.30$\times$). On NVIDIA DGX Spark, GAAC accelerates decode attention at a 64K-token context by 1.19-1.27$\times$ and end-to-end W4A16 decode steps by 1.04-1.15$\times$. In serving, it reduces resident KV memory by approximately 26% and increases aggregate throughput by 13-29% under comparable KV-memory budgets. On Apple M4, GAAC achieves 1.02-1.25$\times$ attention speedups, demonstrating portability beyond NVIDIA GPUs.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程价值明显，但方法新颖性中等且证据仍需加强
pros: 聚焦KV缓存瓶颈，提出无损压缩并结合在线重构，系统设计完整
跨模型与跨硬件给出吞吐和时延收益，兼顾实用性与可移植性
cons: 压缩率提升幅度有限，核心思想主要依赖指数冗余编码，新颖性边际不高
摘要未体现充分消融与统计显著性分析，收益稳定性与边界条件仍不清晰

papers.title_zh: GAAC：无损 KV 压缩，在个人设备上实现带宽高效的 LLM 推理
papers.summary_zh: 仅权重、有损量化大大降低了服务大型语言模型 (LLM) 的存储和内存需求，但不断增长的键值 (KV) 缓存仍然是个人设备上长上下文推理的瓶颈。我们提出了组自适应加法编解码器（GAAC），这是一种无损 KV 压缩和服务系统，它利用指数冗余来减少存储并加速注意力，而无需引入 KV 近似。 GAAC 在连续范围内使用校准的每通道基数加偏移代码对 BF16 指数进行编码。 GAAC 可以跨小组调整代码宽度，同时逐位保留 KV 值。融合注意力内核动态重建 KV 切片，避免全缓存解压缩。块式压缩和固定容量插槽支持增量缓存更新和分页服务。在五个测试模型中，GAAC 实现了 1.405-1.407$\times$ 无损 BF16 KV 压缩。我们还研究了低精度张量 FP8 E4M3 缓存（1.09-1.14$\times$）和 E5M2 缓存（1.25-1.30$\times$）的压缩性能。在 NVIDIA DGX Spark 上，GAAC 将 64K 令牌上下文中的解码注意力加速了 1.19-1.27$\times$，将端到端 W4A16 解码步骤加速了 1.04-1.15$\times$。在服务方面，在相当的 KV 内存预算下，它减少了约 26% 的驻留 KV 内存，并将总吞吐量提高了 13-29%。在 Apple M4 上，GAAC 实现了 1.02-1.25$\times$ 注意力加速，展示了超越 NVIDIA GPU 的可移植性。

papers.title: Answer-Only Disclosure: Private-Context LLM Assistance over Web APIs with a Leakage Ledger
papers.summary: Web assistants increasingly answer questions about a user's private documents by pairing a small on-device model with a cloud LLM behind a Web API. In collaborative decoding, the document stays on the client, and the cloud receives only a public view that the user approves, such as the question alone, but the two models exchange messages while the answer is generated. We show that the message transcript can disclose private content that neither the public view nor the answer contains. In a planted-secret audit, speculative decoding with private drafts did not include the secret code in its answers, yet sent the code to the cloud in rejected drafts. We present ADLER, a decoding protocol for streaming LLM APIs in which every message to the cloud depends only on the public view and the answer the user sees, regardless of how the client combines the two models or how the cloud behaves. A client-side leakage ledger then bounds how much the answer itself reveals relative to a public reference process built from the cloud's replies. In the audit, no ADLER configuration exposed the secret beyond the answer. On GSM8K math problems with numerical values masked in the cloud's input, ADLER with an unlimited leakage budget raises the exact-match accuracy of a 0.5B client from 0.41 to 0.83 and of a 1.5B client from 0.67 to 0.85 under lenient answer parsing, close to the 0.92 achieved by uploading the full problem. It also exceeds a zero-leakage program baseline (0.69) by 0.14 and 0.16, respectively. In this baseline, the cloud writes a program that the client runs offline using the private numbers. The ledger records the disclosure charge associated with this gain; budgets of 16 nats or less leave accuracy near the cloud-only baseline on GSM8K.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方法新颖且实用，但证据仍需更全面。
pros: 明确揭示协同解码中“答案外泄露”这一被低估风险，并给出可审计威胁模型
提出与解码策略解耦的协议与泄露台账，兼顾隐私约束与较高任务性能
cons: 实验范围偏窄（主要为GSM8K与植入审计），对开放域任务、长上下文和对抗云端行为的泛化与稳健性证据不足

papers.title_zh: 仅回答披露：通过 Web API 和泄漏账本提供私人上下文 LLM 协助
papers.summary_zh: Web 助理越来越多地通过将小型设备模型与 Web API 背后的云 LLM 配对来回答有关用户私人文档的问题。在协作解码中，文档保留在客户端，云仅接收用户批准的公共视图，例如单独的问题，但两个模型在生成答案时交换消息。我们证明消息记录可以泄露公共视图和答案都不包含的私人内容。在植入秘密审计中，使用私人草稿进行的推测性解码并未在其答案中包含秘密代码，而是将代码以被拒绝的草稿发送到云端。我们提出了 ADLER，一种用于流式 LLM API 的解码协议，其中发送到云的每条消息仅取决于公共视图和用户看到的答案，而不管客户端如何组合这两个模型或云的行为如何。然后，客户端泄漏分类账会限制答案本身相对于根据云回复构建的公共参考流程所揭示的程度。在审计中，没有任何 ADLER 配置暴露了答案之外的秘密。对于云输入中隐藏数值的 GSM8K 数学问题，具有无限泄漏预算的 ADLER 在宽松的答案解析下将 0.5B 客户端的精确匹配精度从 0.41 提高到 0.83，将 1.5B 客户端的精确匹配精度从 0.67 提高到 0.85，接近上传完整问题所达到的 0.92。它还分别超出零泄漏计划基线 (0.69) 0.14 和 0.16。在此基线中，云编写了一个程序，客户端使用私人号码离线运行。账本记录与此收益相关的披露费用； 16 纳特或更少的预算使得 GSM8K 上的精度接近纯云基线。

papers.title: Nemotron 3.5 Super and Lightning: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Models for Agentic AI
papers.summary: We introduce Nemotron 3.5 Super and Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, open and efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer models designed for reasoning, long-context understanding, and agentic workloads. Super is a 120B-parameter, 12B-active multimodal model, while Lightning is a smaller 30B-parameter, 3B-active text model; both designed for efficient deployment. Both models combine large-scale distillation, long-context training, and native speculative decoding, while Super further incorporates Indic continued pretraining and agentic software-engineering mid-training. We develop a comprehensive post-training pipeline spanning supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning (RLVR and RLHF), complemented in Super by specialized teacher training and multi- teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). This transforms Super from a text-only base model into a multimodal agent capable of reasoning over text, images, video, and interactive tool environments. We further explore test-time scaling through parallel agent execution and self-verification. Across training and deployment, we jointly optimize capability and efficiency. Indic continued pretraining improves Indian-language benchmarks by up to 9.82 percentage points, while agentic mid-training strengthens software-engineering capabilities and robustness across agent harnesses. The post-trained Super model achieves 51.78% on SWE-bench Pro, surpassing Nemotron 3 Ultra despite using approximately 4.6x fewer active parameters. Post-training MTP boosting improves speculative- decoding acceptance length by up to 21.8% under probabilistic draft sampling, while NVFP4 quantization achieves 99.62% median accuracy recovery relative to BF16. Inference optimizations enable up to 4,856 output tokens/s/GPU on GB200 while sustaining at least 50 tokens/s/user.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程整合很强，但核心方法新意有限。
pros: 面向推理与部署的端到端协同优化完整，覆盖训练到量化与推理加速
报告了多项与实用场景强相关指标（SWE-bench、长上下文、吞吐与并发）并体现规模效率优势
cons: 摘要以结果罗列为主，关键对照与消融细节不足，难判断各组件独立贡献
方法创新更多是已有技术组合（MoE、蒸馏、RLHF、spec decoding），理论或机制层面突破不突出

papers.title_zh: Nemotron 3.5 Super 和 Lightning：用于代理 AI 的开放、高效专家混合 Mamba-Transformer 模型
papers.summary_zh: 我们推出 Nemotron 3.5 Super 和 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning，这是开放且高效的专家混合 Mamba-Transformer 模型，专为推理、长上下文理解和代理工作负载而设计。 Super是一个120B参数、12B主动多模态模型，而Lightning是一个较小的30B参数、3B主动文本模型；两者都是为了高效部署而设计的。两种模型都结合了大规模蒸馏、长上下文训练和本机推测解码，而 Super 进一步结合了 Indic 持续预训练和代理软件工程中期训练。我们开发了一个全面的培训后管道，涵盖监督微调和强化学习（RLVR 和 RLHF），并在 Super 中通过专业教师培训和多教师策略蒸馏（MOPD）进行补充。这将 Super 从纯文本基础模型转变为能够对文本、图像、视频和交互式工具环境进行推理的多模式代理。我们通过并行代理执行和自我验证进一步探索测试时间扩展。在培训和部署过程中，我们共同优化能力和效率。 Indic 持续预训练将印度语言基准提高了 9.82 个百分点，而代理中期培训则增强了软件工程能力和跨代理工具的稳健性。训练后的 Super 模型在 SWE-bench Pro 上达到了 51.78%，尽管使用的有效参数减少了大约 4.6 倍，但仍超过了 Nemotron 3 Ultra。训练后 MTP 提升在概率草稿采样下将推测解码接受长度提高了 21.8%，而 NVFP4 量化相对于 BF16 实现了 99.62% 的中值精度恢复。推理优化可在 GB200 上实现高达 4,856 个输出令牌/秒/GPU，同时维持至少 50 个令牌/秒/用户。

papers.title: GAUSS: A Workload-Aware Analytical and Monte-Carlo Simulator for LLM Inference Serving
papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) inference has become an operational workload that fleets must provision, monitor, and bill against latency service-level objectives (SLOs). A single throughput number cannot answer the questions operators actually face, because generative serving couples two phases with very different service characteristics, continuous batching reshapes the effective service process, and user-visible tail latency can degrade long before aggregate throughput saturates. We present GAUSS, a workload-aware analytical and Monte-Carlo simulator that predicts the full distributions of time-to-first-token (TTFT) and time-between-tokens (TBT), together with the sustainable request rate, for a given workload, engine, and accelerator. GAUSS pairs calibrated, phase-specific latency surfaces for prefill and decode with a Lindley-recurrence model of queueing under stochastic arrivals and estimates performance by ensemble Monte-Carlo sampling rather than by replaying a single trace. This lets GAUSS reason about workloads, routing policies, and hardware that have never been deployed, and to capture the latency tails that trace-driven simulators systematically under-sample. We describe the model and show how it supports operating-point selection, traffic segmentation, and shortest-remaining-processing-time scheduling capacity questions that trace-driven simulators cannot address.

papers.title_zh: GAUSS：用于 LLM 推理服务的工作负载感知分析和蒙特卡罗模拟器
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 推理已成为车队必须根据延迟服务级别目标 (SLO) 进行配置、监控和计费的操作工作负载。单个吞吐量数字无法回答运营商实际面临的问题，因为生成服务将两个服务特性截然不同的阶段耦合在一起，连续批处理重塑了有效的服务流程，并且用户可见的尾部延迟可能会在总吞吐量饱和之前很久就降低。我们推出了 GAUSS，一种工作负载感知分析和蒙特卡罗模拟器，它可以预测给定工作负载、引擎和加速器的首次令牌时间 (TTFT) 和令牌间隔时间 (TBT) 的完整分布，以及可持续请求率。 GAUSS 将经过校准的、特定于相位的延迟表面与随机到达下排队的 Lindley 递归模型配对以进行预填充和解码，并通过整体蒙特卡罗采样而不是通过重放单个迹线来估计性能。这使得 GAUSS 能够对从未部署的工作负载、路由策略和硬件进行推理，并捕获跟踪驱动的模拟器系统地采样不足的延迟尾部。我们描述了该模型并展示了它如何支持跟踪驱动模拟器无法解决的操作点选择、流量分段和最短剩余处理时间调度容量问题。

papers.title: Merge and Branch: Efficient Tree-Structured Supervised Fine-Tuning of LLMs for Recommendation
papers.summary: LLM-based generative recommendation reads long, text-rich interaction histories but generates only short semantic identifiers (SIDs). This asymmetry makes supervised fine-tuning inefficient: encoding the history is expensive, yet each history usually provides supervision for only one target. We present Merge and Branch (M&B) to reduce input cost and learn more from each encoded history. Merge compresses each historical item's SID and text into a small number of learned tokens. Branch uses the compressed history to predict multiple target SIDs. To share history computation while keeping these targets independent, M&B organizes each example as a shallow, wide tree. We develop tree FlashAttention to execute this layout efficiently, processing the shared history once and propagating gradients from every branch for end-to-end training. A tree-structured key/value cache extends history sharing to constrained decoding. Experiments on public benchmarks show that M&B outperforms strong recommendation baselines while substantially improving training and decoding efficiency.

papers.title_zh: 合并和分支：法学硕士的高效树结构监督微调以供推荐
papers.summary_zh: 基于 LLM 的生成推荐读取长的、文本丰富的交互历史，但仅生成短的语义标识符 (SID)。这种不对称性使得监督微调效率低下：对历史记录进行编码的成本很高，但每个历史记录通常只为一个目标提供监督。我们提出合并和分支（M＆B）来减少输入成本并从每个编码历史中了解更多信息。合并将每个历史项目的 SID 和文本压缩为少量的学习令牌。 Branch 使用压缩历史记录来预测多个目标 SID。为了共享历史计算，同时保持这些目标独立，M&B 将每个示例组织为一棵浅而宽的树。我们开发树 FlashAttention 来有效地执行此布局，处理共享历史一次并从每个分支传播梯度以进行端到端训练。树形结构的键/值缓存将历史共享扩展到受限解码。公共基准测试表明，M&B 的性能优于强推荐基线，同时大幅提高了训练和解码效率。

papers.title: FAD-KV: Adaptive Dictionary KV Caching for Efficient Reasoning Decoding
papers.summary: Key-value (KV) caching is a core mechanism in large language models, where intermediate key and value representations are stored to accelerate autoregressive decoding. As generation length increases, KV cache memory and computation grow linearly, making compression critical for efficient long-output reasoning. Dictionary-based sparse KV compression is appealing because it represents each token's KV states as a sparse combination of learned basis elements (atoms) in a dictionary, preserving token-level structure without enforcing a global low-rank constraint. However, existing dictionary-based methods face two practical limitations during decoding: iterative sparse coding methods such as Orthogonal Matching Pursuit add decoding-time overhead, and static dictionaries may mismatch evolving KV distributions under test-time generation. While adaptive dictionary updates can reduce this mismatch, naive append-only strategies lead to dictionary growth during generation. We propose FAD-KV, a \textbf{F}ast \textbf{A}daptive \textbf{D}ictionary KV caching framework for efficient reasoning decoding. FAD-KV integrates (i) a screening-based sparse coding scheme, where a one-shot Top-\(n\) selection identifies a small candidate pool followed by lightweight coefficient refinement, and (ii) a fixed-size dictionary adaptation mechanism that reuses inactive atoms instead of expanding the dictionary. By controlling both sparse coding cost and adaptive dictionary growth, FAD-KV provides a memory-bounded and computation-efficient KV compression framework for long reasoning workloads. Experiments on reasoning and long-context benchmarks show that FAD-KV achieves a strong quality-efficiency trade-off while avoiding unbounded dictionary growth during decoding.

papers.title_zh: FAD-KV：用于高效推理解码的自适应字典 KV 缓存
papers.summary_zh: 键值（KV）缓存是大型语言模型中的核心机制，其中存储中间键和值表示以加速自回归解码。随着生成长度的增加，KV 缓存和计算量呈线性增长，这使得压缩对于高效的长输出推理至关重要。基于字典的稀疏 KV 压缩很有吸引力，因为它将每个标记的 KV 状态表示为字典中学习的基本元素（原子）的稀疏组合，从而保留标记级结构而不强制执行全局低秩约束。然而，现有的基于字典的方法在解码过程中面临两个实际限制：迭代稀疏编码方法（例如正交匹配追踪）增加了解码时间开销，并且静态字典可能在测试时生成下与不断变化的 KV 分布不匹配。虽然自适应字典更新可以减少这种不匹配，但简单的仅追加策略会导致字典在生成过程中增长。我们提出了 FAD-KV，一个用于高效推理解码的 \textbf{F}ast \textbf{A}daptive \textbf{D}ictionary KV 缓存框架。 FAD-KV 集成了（i）基于筛选的稀疏编码方案，其中一次性 Top-\(n\) 选择识别一个小的候选池，然后进行轻量级系数细化，以及（ii）固定大小的字典适应机制，重用不活动原子而不是扩展字典。通过控制稀疏编码成本和自适应字典增长，FAD-KV 为长推理工作负载提供了内存有限且计算高效的 KV 压缩框架。推理和长上下文基准测试表明，FAD-KV 实现了强大的质量效率权衡，同时避免了解码过程中字典的无限增长。

papers.title: ConfluxServe: Reconciling Resource Utilization and Parallelism Efficiency across Prefill and Decode in LLM Serving
papers.summary: Prefill and decode are complementary in resource usage, but often divergent in parallelism preferences. Executing the two phases separately preserves their preferred parallelism but leaves complementary resources underutilized, while co-batching improves utilization but often requires a uniform parallel configuration that hurts execution efficiency. To resolve this utilization-efficiency dilemma, we propose Conflux Parallelism (XP), a parallel execution abstraction that co-executes prefill and decode with different parallelism within the same batch. Conflux Parallelism exploits operator-level Transformer structure to construct a heterogeneous execution path with different batching and parallelism strategies across operators, combining the best of co-batching and phase-specific execution. Building on Conflux Parallelism, we design ConfluxServe, an SLO-aware serving system that maximizes cluster goodput under TTFT and TBT constraints. Evaluation on production workloads shows that ConfluxServe improves serving goodput by 1.26-1.62x over the strongest baselines.

papers.title_zh: ConfluxServe：协调 LLM 服务中预填充和解码的资源利用率和并行效率
papers.summary_zh: 预填充和解码在资源使用方面是互补的，但在并行性偏好方面通常有所不同。分别执行两个阶段可以保留其首选的并行性，但会导致互补资源未得到充分利用，而联合批处理可以提高利用率，但通常需要统一的并行配置，从而损害执行效率。为了解决这种利用效率的困境，我们提出了 Conflux Parallelism (XP)，这是一种并行执行抽象，可以在同一批次内以不同的并行度共同执行预填充和解码。 Conflux Parallelism 利用算子级 Transformer 结构来构建异构执行路径，在算子之间具有不同的批处理和并行策略，结合了协同批处理和特定阶段执行的最佳性能。基于 Conflux 并行性，我们设计了 ConfluxServe，这是一个 SLO 感知服务系统，可在 TTFT 和 TBT 约束下最大化集群吞吐量。对生产工作负载的评估表明，ConfluxServe 将服务吞吐量比最强基线提高了 1.26-1.62 倍。

papers.title: Selective and Hybrid-State Communication for Latent Multi-Agent Systems
papers.summary: Efficient communication remains a major bottleneck in large language model multiagent systems. Latent communication reduces repeated natural-language exchange by transferring internal model states between agents, but these transfers remain costly and are typically designed around conventional KV-cache representations. We address this problem from two complementary perspectives. We introduce SelectKV, a boundary-aware method that selectively communicates KV states while protecting inherited context, and HyLaMAS, which extends latent collaboration to hybrid linear-attention models by communicating both KV caches and recurrent states through a shared workspace. Across six benchmarks, SelectKV reduces communicated KV positions and logical KV payload by 9.7-9.9%, with accuracy unchanged on two benchmarks, within one percentage point on three, and six points lower on HumanEval+. Across Qwen3.5 model scales, HyLaMAS reduces decoded output tokens by 53-80% and achieves 1.16-2.78x speedups relative to text-based multi-agent communication. Together, these independently evaluated methods represent two complementary approaches to efficient latent-state communication across conventional Transformer and hybrid model architectures.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Resource-Aware Agentic AI (RAAAI)

papers.title_zh: 潜在多智能体系统的选择性和混合状态通信
papers.summary_zh: 高效通信仍然是大型语言模型多智能体系统的主要瓶颈。潜在通信通过在代理之间传输内部模型状态来减少重复的自然语言交换，但这些传输仍然成本高昂，并且通常是围绕传统的 KV 缓存表示设计的。我们从两个互补的角度来解决这个问题。我们引入了 SelectKV，一种边界感知方法，可以选择性地通信 KV 状态，同时保护继承的上下文；以及 HyLaMAS，它通过共享工作区通信 KV 缓存和循环状态，将潜在协作扩展到混合线性注意力模型。在六个基准测试中，SelectKV 将通信的 KV 位置和逻辑 KV 有效负载减少了 9.7-9.9%，两个基准测试的准确度没有变化，比三个基准测试低 1 个百分点，在 HumanEval+ 上降低了 6 个百分点。在 Qwen3.5 模型规模上，HyLaMAS 将解码输出标记减少了 53-80%，并相对于基于文本的多代理通信实现了 1.16-2.78 倍的加速。总之，这些独立评估的方法代表了跨传统 Transformer 和混合模型架构进行高效潜在状态通信的两种互补方法。

papers.title: Multi-Draft On-Policy Distillation for Diffusion Drafters
papers.summary: Speculative decoding is used to reduce the inference cost of language models. One-step diffusion drafters propose a block of multiple tokens in parallel, reducing the sequential cost of speculative decoding. On-policy distillation trains these drafters using verifier feedback on their own proposals. However, parallel drafting makes this feedback difficult to use: the drafter predicts each token without observing the preceding tokens sampled within the same block, while the verifier conditions its prediction on those tokens. Different sampled prefixes therefore give different verifier targets for the same drafter prediction. We show that distilling against these targets separately can suppress tokens that are plausible after some prefixes but unlikely after others, harming draft acceptance. We explain the effects of this mismatch and introduce Multi-Draft On-Policy Distillation (MDraft), a new parallel drafter distillation method which samples several draft blocks from the same context and aggregates the verifier's full-vocabulary conditionals across their prefixes. We use all the drafts to collect information from the verifier, allowing support from alternative prefixes to influence the training target. The resulting algorithm improves the acceptance length of a parallel drafter beyond the level of pre-training, and alleviates the effects of the distributional mismatch. MDraft changes only training, retaining the drafter's architecture and inference procedure, allowing the resulting drafter to be used as-is in place of the pretrained checkpoint. Experiments on a suite of mathematical, coding, and conversational tasks show longer accepted drafts than prior distillation methods.

papers.title_zh: 适用于扩散牵伸机的多牵伸按策略蒸馏
papers.summary_zh: 推测解码用于降低语言模型的推理成本。一步扩散起草者提出并行多个令牌的块，减少推测解码的顺序成本。政策蒸馏利用验证者对自己提案的反馈来培训这些起草者。然而，并行起草使得这种反馈难以使用：起草者在不观察同一块内采样的先前令牌的情况下预测每个令牌，而验证者则根据这些令牌进行预测。因此，不同的采样前缀为相同的起草者预测提供了不同的验证者目标。我们表明，分别针对这些目标进行提炼可以抑制在某些前缀后看似合理但在其他前缀后不太可能的标记，从而损害草案的接受。我们解释了这种不匹配的影响，并引入了多草案按策略蒸馏（MDraft），这是一种新的并行起草者蒸馏方法，它从同一上下文中采样多个草稿块，并在其前缀上聚合验证者的完整词汇条件。我们使用所有草稿从验证者那里收集信息，允许替代前缀的支持来影响训练目标。由此产生的算法将并行起草器的接受长度提高到超出预训练的水平，并减轻了分布不匹配的影响。 MDraft 仅更改训练，保留绘图器的架构和推理程序，允许按原样使用生成的绘图器来代替预训练的检查点。对一系列数学、编码和对话任务的实验表明，比以前的蒸馏方法接受的草稿更长。

papers.title: Kernel Performance Engineering under Physical Non-Idealities
papers.summary: Physical non-idealities in integrated circuit (IC) design and fabrication are concealed by conventional hardware abstractions, yet they can limit kernel performance and obscure optimization opportunities. Using distributed shared memory (DSMEM) on NVIDIA H100 GPUs as a case study, we show how floorsweeping restricts hardware resources available for clustered execution, potentially offsetting the benefits of reduced data movement enabled by DSMEM. Guided by these insights, we develop a wave-aware clustering strategy that accounts for these resource constraints to improve kernel performance. Evaluations using a global-load-and-broadcast microbenchmark, GEMM, and the Hopper version of FlashAttention 4 demonstrate the performance implications of these constraints, with wave-aware clustering improving FlashAttention 4 throughput by up to 5.30% over its baseline. We further show that, under thermal design power (TDP) limits, reduced data movement enables higher Streaming Multiprocessor (SM) frequencies through Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling (DVFS), explaining otherwise unexpected throughput improvements. Extending this analysis beyond GPUs, we show that power constraints also limit throughput scaling on Tenstorrent's Wormhole accelerator, highlighting the broader importance of accounting for physical non-idealities when analyzing and optimizing kernel performance.

papers.title_zh: 非理想物理条件下的内核性能工程
papers.summary_zh: 集成电路 (IC) 设计和制造中的物理非理想性被传统的硬件抽象所掩盖，但它们可能会限制内核性能并掩盖优化机会。我们以 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上的分布式共享内存 (DSMEM) 为案例研究，展示了地板扫描如何限制可用于集群执行的硬件资源，从而可能抵消 DSMEM 减少数据移动带来的好处。在这些见解的指导下，我们开发了一种波感知集群策略，该策略考虑了这些资源限制，以提高内核性能。使用全局加载和广播微基准、GEMM 和 FlashAttention 4 Hopper 版本的评估展示了这些限制的性能影响，波感知集群将 FlashAttention 4 吞吐量比其基准提高了 5.30%。我们进一步表明，在热设计功耗 (TDP) 限制下，减少数据移动可以通过动态电压和频率调节 (DVFS) 实现更高的流式多处理器 (SM) 频率，从而解释了意想不到的吞吐量改进。将这一分析扩展到 GPU 之外，我们发现功耗限制也限制了 Tenstorrent 虫洞加速器的吞吐量扩展，这凸显了在分析和优化内核性能时考虑物理非理想性的更广泛重要性。

papers.title: Bayesian Inference of Expensive Simulators: Survey and Comparison of Design Choices
papers.summary: We present a survey of approaches to Bayesian inference with simulator forward models, focusing on settings with prohibitively expensive simulators. In this domain, Bayesian optimization-based methods have emerged as the most promising approach. We unify existing methods into a general framework, enabling consistent reasoning about shared algorithmic structure across the fragmented literature. Within this framework, we identify the primary design choices and perform a systematic empirical comparison of their effects on inference efficiency in terms of required simulation budget. A key result of our study is that inference efficiency is often dominated by the choice of surrogate-model response variable, as it directly governs the complexity of the modeled function. Specifically, we demonstrate that the prevalent scalar log-likelihood is a poor response variable, as it discards crucial information. Based on this insight, we introduce the concept of custom \emph{proxy variables}: transformations of simulator outputs engineered to retain more information and provide smoother response surfaces, substantially improving inference efficiency over standard response variables. We provide actionable guidance and a numerically robust Julia package to facilitate practical adoption of Bayesian optimization for simulator inverse problems.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 8 figures. Accepted for publication in Statistics and Computing. This is the submitted manuscript; the revised version, including changes based on peer review, is available from the authors upon request

papers.title_zh: 昂贵模拟器的贝叶斯推理：设计选择的调查和比较
papers.summary_zh: 我们对模拟器前向模型的贝叶斯推理方法进行了调查，重点关注极其昂贵的模拟器的设置。在这个领域，基于贝叶斯优化的方法已成为最有前途的方法。我们将现有方法统一到一个通用框架中，从而能够对分散的文献中的共享算法结构进行一致的推理。在此框架内，我们确定了主要的设计选择，并根据所需的模拟预算对它们对推理效率的影响进行了系统的实证比较。我们研究的一个关键结果是，推理效率通常由代理模型响应变量的选择决定，因为它直接控制建模函数的复杂性。具体来说，我们证明普遍的标量对数似然是一个较差的响应变量，因为它丢弃了关键信息。基于这一见解，我们引入了自定义 \emph{代理变量} 的概念：模拟器输出的转换旨在保留更多信息并提供更平滑的响应面，从而显着提高标准响应变量的推理效率。我们提供可操作的指导和数值稳健的 Julia 包，以促进模拟器逆问题的贝叶斯优化的实际采用。

papers.title: DCKV: Learned Transform Coding of the Prompt KV Cache in Hybrid Language Models
papers.summary: Hybrid language models keep a key-value (KV) cache only in their few full-attention layers, but this cache is still the part of a prompt's state that grows with the prompt and that must be stored or moved to reuse it. We present DCKV, a differentiable codec for the KV cache and the first KV-cache codec that is trained end to end. Its transform, its quantizer and its entropy models, which are conditioned on the prompt tokens and on already decoded neighbouring positions, are optimized together against the frozen language model, both for the code length that the entropy models assign and for the change of the model's output. On Qwen3.5-2B, DCKV stores a compressed token in more than 55 times fewer bytes than bf16 at a loss of at most 1.8 points on three long-context benchmarks, and in more than 100 times fewer bytes at a loss of at most 3.6 points.

papers.title_zh: DCKV：混合语言模型中提示 KV 缓存的学习转换编码
papers.summary_zh: 混合语言模型仅在少数全注意力层中保留键值 (KV) 缓存，但此缓存仍然是提示状态的一部分，随着提示的增长而增长，并且必须存储或移动才能重用它。我们提出了 DCKV，一种用于 KV 缓存的可微分编解码器，也是第一个经过端到端训练的 KV 缓存编解码器。它的变换、量化器和熵模型以提示标记和已解码的相邻位置为条件，针对熵模型分配的代码长度和模型输出的变化，针对冻结语言模型一起进行优化。在 Qwen3.5-2B 上，DCKV 存储压缩令牌的字节数比 bf16 少 55 倍以上，在三个长上下文基准测试中最多损失 1.8 分，而在三个长上下文基准测试中，DCKV 存储压缩令牌的字节数减少 100 倍以上，最多损失 3.6 分。

papers.title: God Does Not Play Dice: Enforcing Batch Invariance in Agentic Kernel Generation
papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) serving systems dynamically batch user requests for GPU execution, so the same request may be processed alongside different requests across runs. If the GPU kernels lack batch invariance (BI), this changing batch context can alter the numerical output for an unchanged input, undermining reproducibility. Existing kernel generation agents focus on correctness and efficiency but \emph{overlook BI}. We find 19 confirmed BI violations among 83 batch-applicable released artifacts. To address this limitation, we propose \tool, which combines contract-guided static dependency analysis with dynamic validation of bitwise consistency across batch contexts. \tool is designed as a plug-in component for general kernel agents, allowing their original optimization capabilities to be reused while adding BI enforcement. We integrate it as successive acceptance gates in the optimization loop, rejecting structurally risky or dynamically non-invariant candidates before performance benchmarking and returning feedback to the agent. Experiments across three agent frameworks under baseline and BI-aware generation on real world LLM serving tasks show that \tool improves the BI pass rate from 67.6\% to 91.9\% while retaining 91.8\% of the baseline geometric mean speedup. These results demonstrate that \tool can be incorporated into kernel optimization by agents as an additional reliability objective alongside correctness and speed.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题重要且方案实用，但证据深度有限
pros: 抓住了LLM serving中被忽视的批不变性可靠性痛点，研究动机强

papers.title_zh: 上帝不掷骰子：在代理内核生成中强制执行批次不变性
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 服务系统动态批处理用于 GPU 执行的用户请求，因此同一请求可以在运行期间与不同请求一起处理。如果 GPU 内核缺乏批量不变性 (BI)，则这种不断变化的批量上下文可能会改变未更改输入的数值输出，从而破坏再现性。现有的内核生成代理注重正确性和效率，但\emph{忽略了 BI}。我们在 83 个批量适用的已发布工件中发现了 19 个已确认的 BI 违规行为。为了解决这个限制，我们提出了 \tool ，它将契约引导的静态依赖分析与跨批处理上下文的按位一致性的动态验证结合起来。 \tool 被设计为通用内核代理的插件组件，允许在添加 BI 强制的同时重用其原始优化功能。我们将其作为优化循环中的连续接受门进行集成，在性能基准测试并将反馈返回给代理之前拒绝结构上有风险或动态非不变的候选者。在现实世界 LLM 服务任务上的基线和 BI 感知生成下的三个代理框架的实验表明，该工具将 BI 通过率从 67.6% 提高到 91.9%，同时保留了 91.8% 的基线几何平均加速。这些结果表明，\tool 可以被代理纳入内核优化中，作为除了正确性和速度之外的附加可靠性目标。

papers.title: Folding Attention Biases into Keys Makes Compacted KV Caches Run on Standard Kernels
papers.summary: Attention Matching (AM) compacts a KV cache by keeping some keys per head, refitting their values and adding a bias to each kept key's logit. FlashAttention and vLLM's paged caches have no input for it. We fold the bias into the keys along one closed-form direction per head, fitted on context queries, giving a plain cache with AM's size and head dimension and the model's own query path; the output error is bounded by how far each query's projection on that direction is from 1. With equal per-head budgets, unmodified vLLM serves folded caches through a KV connector, matching Hugging Face's answers on all 51 Qwen3-4B questions and its greedy output on 180 of 200 Qwen3-14B LongBench samples. With equal budgets on QuALITY (Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, 8B, Llama-3.1-8B) and LongHealth (three Qwen3 models), the fold is within noise of AM's accuracy in 13 of 14 settings, with lower KL to the full cache than dropping the bias in all 12 where both ran. Under the published per-head budgets, on Qwen3-4B, its Instruct-2507 variant and Llama-3.1-8B, it is within noise of AM in 9 of 10, no longer beats dropping the bias in KL, and the two each win once in accuracy.

quality.label: 较高

papers.title_zh: 将注意力偏差折叠到键中使紧凑的 KV 缓存在标准内核上运行
papers.summary_zh: 注意力匹配 (AM) 通过在每个头保留一些键、重新调整它们的值并向每个保留键的 logit 添加偏差来压缩 KV 缓存。 FlashAttention 和 vLLM 的分页缓存没有输入。我们沿着每个头的一个封闭形式方向将偏差折叠到键中，适合上下文查询，给出一个具有 AM 大小和头尺寸以及模型自己的查询路径的普通缓存；输出误差受限于每个查询在该方向上的投影距 1 的距离。在每个头预算相等的情况下，未修改的 vLLM 通过 KV 连接器提供折叠缓存，匹配 Hugging Face 在所有 51 个 Qwen3-4B 问题上的答案及其在 200 个 Qwen3-14B LongBench 样本中的 180 个上的贪婪输出。在 QuALITY（Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B、Llama-3.1-8B）和 LongHealth（三个 Qwen3 模型）上的预算相同的情况下，在 14 个设置中的 13 个设置中，折叠在 AM 精度的噪音范围内，与在所有 12 个设置中都运行的所有 12 个设置中降低偏差相比，全缓存的 KL 更低。根据公布的人均预算，在 Qwen3-4B、其 Instruct-2507 变体和 Llama-3.1-8B 上，10 次中有 9 次都在 AM 的噪音范围内，不再击败在 KL 中放弃偏差，并且两者在准确度上各赢一次。

papers.title: WAKMan: Workload Aware KVCache Manager
papers.summary: Prefix caching enables a Large Language Model (LLM) servers to reuse the Key-Value (KV) states and accelerate prefill computation stage for requests that share a prefix with earlier prompts, thus reducing latency and serving cost. With limited memory resource, the KV cache eviction policy becomes a decisive factor in determining the overall benefits of prefix caching. Production traffic may have single-turn, multi-turn, agentic, or a mixture of any combination of these request types. Our findings indicate that agentic steps return within seconds and favor recency, while popular prompts and long conversations return after many other requests and favor frequency. Across 20 mixes, no single policy is always best: vLLM's default strategy LRU provides 12% higher cache hits as compared to the frequency-oriented S3FIFO on agentic-heavy mixes but trails it by up to 22% elsewhere, and even a single workload parameter can flip the winner even for any particular mix. We present WAKMan, a workload-aware KV cache manager that picks its eviction policy from live traffic without knowing request types or reading prompts. It improves hit rate over LRU by 5 percentage points on average, with the lowest mean and worst-case optimality gap of all policies.
papers.comment: Work done during internship at Capital One

papers.title_zh: WAKMan：工作负载感知 KVCache 管理器
papers.summary_zh: 前缀缓存使大型语言模型 (LLM) 服务器能够重用键值 (KV) 状态，并加速与早期提示共享前缀的请求的预填充计算阶段，从而减少延迟和服务成本。在内存资源有限的情况下，KV缓存驱逐策略成为决定前缀缓存整体效益的决定性因素。生产流量可以具有单轮、多轮、代理或这些请求类型的任意组合的混合。我们的研究结果表明，代理步骤会在几秒钟内返回，并且有利于新近度，而流行的提示和长时间对话会在许多其他请求和偏好频率之后返回。在 20 种混合中，没有单一策略总是最好的：与代理重的混合上面向频率的 S3FIFO 相比，vLLM 的默认策略 LRU 提供的缓存命中率高出 12%，但在其他地方落后了 22%，甚至对于任何特定的混合，即使是单个工作负载参数也可以翻转获胜者。我们推出了 WAKMan，这是一种工作负载感知的 KV 缓存管理器，它可以在不知道请求类型或阅读提示的情况下从实时流量中选择驱逐策略。与 LRU 相比，它的命中率平均提高了 5 个百分点，并且在所有策略中均值和最坏情况最优性差距最小。

papers.title: CrowdCC: Jointly Benchmarking Corruption Robustness and Deployment Quantization in Crowd Counting
papers.summary: Crowd-counting models deployed on edge devices face two challenges: inputs are degraded along the capture and transmission pipeline, while models are often quantized to satisfy resource constraints of the edge. Yet corruption robustness and deployment quantization are typically evaluated separately. We introduce CrowdCC, a controlled benchmark that jointly evaluates these effects across 23 deployment-motivated corruptions at three severity levels, four crowd-counting datasets, and 26 models. We evaluate TensorRT engines at FP32, FP16, and post-training INT8 precision on an A100 GPU, alongside throughput and energy measurements on corresponding Jetson Orin~NX configurations. The corruptions span six families, with head annotations adjusted when geometry or visibility changes. Our results show that capture-chain corruptions consistently cause the largest degradation across evaluated models, while crowd density affects absolute and relative errors differently. Accuracy on clean images does not reliably predict performance on the corresponding corrupted images. INT8 changes corruption robustness more than FP16, without a consistent direction, and does not consistently improve latency or energy efficiency. INT8 inference efficiency is strongly associated with reformat overhead in the compiled engine, with slowdowns also observed under limited INT8 coverage. Precision changes corrupted-error rankings and robustness--cost frontiers, highlighting the need to consider corruption robustness and deployment cost jointly when selecting models and precision. The code is available at https://github.com/Tulane-Computer-Architecture-Systems/CrowdCC-Release.

papers.title_zh: CrowdCC：对人群计数中的腐败鲁棒性和部署量化进行联合基准测试
papers.summary_zh: 部署在边缘设备上的人群计数模型面临两个转变：输入沿着捕获和传输管道降级，同时模型被量化以满足资源限制。然而，腐败鲁棒性和部署量化通常是分开评估的。我们引入了 CrowdCC，这是一种受控损坏基准，它使用 3 个严重级别的 23 个部署驱动的损坏、4 个人群计数数据集和 26 个使用 A100 TensorRT 引擎（FP32、FP16 和训练后 INT8 精度）的模型，以及相应 Jetson Orin NX 配置的吞吐量和能量测量来联合评估这些影响。损坏跨越六个系列，当几何形状或可见性发生变化时，头部注释会进行调整。我们的评估表明，捕获链损坏始终会在评估的模型中产生最大的退化，而人群密度对绝对误差和相对误差的影响不同。干净的准确性并不能完全预测损坏的性能。 INT8 比 FP16 对损坏鲁棒性的改变要大得多，没有系统性方向，并且不能持续改善延迟或能量。 INT8 推理效率与编译引擎中的重新格式化开销密切相关，而在有限的 INT8 覆盖范围下也观察到速度下降。精度改变了损坏错误排名和鲁棒性成本边界，说明了为什么模型选择必须同时考虑损坏鲁棒性和测量的部署成本。该代码可从 https://github.com/Tulane-Computer-Architecture-Systems/CrowdCC-Release 获取。

papers.title: INC-MoE: Overlapping In-Network Collectives and Expert Computation for Expert-Parallel Mixture-of-Experts Inference
papers.summary: In expert-parallel mixture-of-experts (MoE) serving, dispatch moves tokens to the accelerators hosting their selected experts, and combine returns expert outputs to each token's owner. Both operations lie on the critical path and can dominate MoE layer latency in multi-node deployments. We present INC-MoE, an expert-parallel MoE layer that offloads dispatch and combine to the network switch and overlaps both collectives with each other and with expert computation. Dispatch uses in-network AllGather through switch-side multicast, while combine uses in-network ReduceScatter through switch-side reduction. Both collectives use message semantics between the end hosts and the switch. Because the in-network collectives load opposite directions of each link, executing them concurrently reduces bandwidth-bound communication time by $(N-2)/(2(N-1))$ relative to concurrent ring-based collectives: 33% for four ranks and 43% for eight. INC-MoE partitions tokens into bands and processes them through a three-stage AllGather-feed-forward network (FFN)-ReduceScatter pipeline inside a single persistent kernel. At steady state, role-specialized thread blocks gather the next band, compute the current band, and reduce the previous band concurrently, overlapping both collectives with each other and with computation using device-side synchronization. INC-MoE integrates as a drop-in replacement for the MoE layer of vLLM. We evaluate it in an emulated four-node scale-out deployment with a dedicated accelerator emulating an in-network computing (INC) switch. On OLMoE prefill with four-way expert parallelism, INC-MoE reduces time to first token (TTFT) by up to 33% and increases throughput by up to 50% relative to vLLM's default collective path, while matching its outputs.

papers.title_zh: INC-MoE：用于专家并行混合专家推理的重叠网络内集体和专家计算
papers.summary_zh: 在专家并行专家混合 (MoE) 服务中，调度将代币移动到托管其选定专家的加速器，并将专家输出组合返回给每个代币的所有者。这两种操作都位于关键路径上，并且可以主导多节点部署中的 MoE 层延迟。我们提出了 INC-MoE，这是一个专家并行的 MoE 层，它可以卸载调度并合并到网络交换机，并将两个集合相互重叠并与专家计算重叠。 Dispatch通过交换机端组播使用网内AllGather，而combine通过交换机端归约使用网内ReduceScatter。这两个集合都在终端主机和交换机之间使用消息语义。由于网络内集合加载每个链路的相反方向，因此相对于并发基于环的集合，同时执行它们可将带宽限制的通信时间减少 $(N-2)/(2(N-1))$：四列为 33%，八列为 43%。 INC-MoE 将令牌划分为带，并通过单个持久内核内的三级 AllGather-前馈网络 (FFN)-ReduceScatter 管道对其进行处理。在稳定状态下，角色专用线程块收集下一个带，计算当前带，并同时减少前一个带，使两个集合相互重叠并使用设备端同步进行计算。 INC-MoE 集成为 vLLM MoE 层的直接替代品。我们在模拟的四节点横向扩展部署中对其进行评估，并使用模拟网络内计算 (INC) 交换机的专用加速器。在具有四路专家并行性的 OLMoE 预填充上，相对于 vLLM 的默认集体路径，INC-MoE 将首次令牌时间 (TTFT) 缩短高达 33%，并将吞吐量提高高达 50%，同时匹配其输出。

papers.title: Stratum: Repository Memory for Coding Agents Beyond the Context Window
papers.summary: Context windows have grown a thousand-fold, yet coding agents still start every session with no memory of their past work. They re-read files, retry failed approaches, and forget root causes they established hours earlier. This is not a context-length problem but a memory-architecture problem. Our hypothesis: coding agents need persistent, experience-aware repository memory, so that knowledge survives from one session to the next. Three measurements on real repositories motivate the design. First, mid-size projects already exceed the largest production context windows, and storing knowledge inside the model's key-value (KV) cache costs $10^4$ to $10^5$ times more bytes than storing it as indexed text. Second, across 752 real bug-fix commits, the median fix edits two files, and these files plus their direct imports amount to less than 10% of the repository; the bottleneck is selection, not capacity. Third, even with transitive import reachability and test links, 47% of co-edited file pairs remain structurally disconnected; the knowledge needed for selection must be mined from history and experience. We sketch Stratum, a tiered memory that lives with the repository and serves it through page-safe tools: every response states what was returned, what remains, and what it cost. Retrieval over a store of one million nodes takes 1.7 ms at the median. In a multi-session experiment on eight real bugs, a fresh agent that inherited a prior session's memory, written by a different model, identified the root-cause file in 21 of 24 trials versus 6 of 24 for a retrieval-only baseline (Fisher $p<10^{-4}$), at 4.5x lower median token cost. With the notes of all eight investigations pooled in one store, success remained 8/8.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Replication package: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23615180
